=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text t1 "Move disk "
text t2 " from pole "
text t3 " to pole "
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
fn hanoi n ulong src ulong dst ulong via ulong to void
if eq n 0
ret
end
hanoi sub n 1 src via dst
emit t1
emitu n
emit t2
emitu src
emit t3
emitu dst
emit nl
hanoi sub n 1 via dst src
end
fn main to int
hanoi 4 1 3 2
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
Move disk 1 from pole 1 to pole 2
Move disk 2 from pole 1 to pole 3
Move disk 1 from pole 2 to pole 3
Move disk 3 from pole 1 to pole 2
Move disk 1 from pole 3 to pole 1
Move disk 2 from pole 3 to pole 2
Move disk 1 from pole 1 to pole 2
Move disk 4 from pole 1 to pole 3
Move disk 1 from pole 2 to pole 3
Move disk 2 from pole 2 to pole 1
Move disk 1 from pole 3 to pole 1
Move disk 3 from pole 2 to pole 3
Move disk 1 from pole 1 to pole 2
Move disk 2 from pole 1 to pole 3
Move disk 1 from pole 2 to pole 3
</pre>
